source_grammar: 72 public tuple(edge_from, role_0to3, edge_to) stream from 4 true causal paths each >=8 relation edges plus 40 distractor edges including cross-joins and inverses; no truth labels or target query to online memory policy
test_topology: 3-or-more-way cross joins between separate causal corridors; blinded source birth uses distinct topology generator, not reverse or shuffled F62 events
native_interface: Adapter must reuse SHA-checked F62 actions(memory,event,index,packing) and exact F60 packing codec; no altered F62 functions; learned public score used to select one legal action, pack exactly <=10x12 byte records plus 20 weight bytes and 4 header; no hidden future, question or label
solver_constraint: Original F85 supports only 4 or 6 ops and 12 records; 8+ public causal transfer cannot be claimed without separately source-qualified solver extension; block new unseen first use
cost_rule: Complete training amortized over 32 unseen tasks + 72-event public online inference plus solver <= strongest original F60/F85 and eligible public exact control CPU/ops and peak memory; 144B stored state cap is necessary not sufficient.
